scenes.narration: Cô giáo Ánh bước vào căn nhà nứa nhỏ, đặt ấm nước sôi bên bếp than hồng giữa đêm.
scenes.narration_en: Teacher Anh stepped into the small bamboo house, placing a boiling kettle by the coal stove in the night.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of a Vietnamese female teacher standing inside a rustic dimly lit bamboo hut at night. She holds a ceramic teapot near a warm glowing charcoal fire pit. Background shows simple woven walls and hanging rice baskets. Lighting is soft orange from the fire contrasting with cool blue darkness outside window.

scenes.narration: Bên bếp lửa, cô cầm tay các em nhỏ dân tộc và dạy những nét chữ đầu tiên đầy ấm áp.
scenes.narration_en: By the hearthfire, she holds hands of young ethnic children teaching them their first warm letters.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up vertical shot focusing on an adult female teacher's kind face smiling while holding a small child's hand over a crackling fire. The child wears traditional colorful ethnic textile clothing with silver ornaments. Warm golden light illuminates dust motes dancing in the air inside wooden structure.

scenes.narration: Hơi nước bốc lên, những câu chuyện về mẹ Tổ quốc được kể vang trong không gian nhỏ hẹp này.
scenes.narration_en: Steam rises as stories about Motherland are told echoing within this small confined space.
scenes.image_prompt: Medium vertical shot showing steam rising from kettle near fire pit while teacher points to wooden writing board with carved characters. Children surround her attentively wearing traditional patterns. Background slightly blurred showing mountain silhouette through single window frame.

scenes.narration: Cô giáo Ánh đã đứng bên bếp này hàng nghìn đêm, trao gửi tương lai cho con cháu bản.
scenes.narration_en: Teacher Anh has stood beside this hearth for thousands of nights gifting futures to her village's descendants.
scenes.image_prompt: Wide vertical establishing shot showing teacher standing tall near small fire pit inside round bamboo house at night. Exterior view through doorway reveals misty mountain peaks in distance under starry sky. Interior warm light spills onto dirt floor where children sit cross-legged learning.

scenes.narration: Đến sáng mai, những đứa trẻ ấy sẽ mang tri thức trở về núi cao xây dựng quê hương.
scenes.narration_en: By morning those children will take knowledge back to high mountains building their homeland.
scenes.image_prompt: Morning light filtering through bamboo slats illuminating faces of teacher and children. Teacher gently touches forehead of child who now wears school backpack with national flag colors visible against lush green mountain backdrop outside doorway.

scenes.narration: Ngọn lửa tri thức vẫn rực cháy, thắp sáng ước mơ cho cả một vùng cao rộng lớn.
scenes.narration_en: The fire of knowledge continues burning brightly illuminating dreams for an entire vast highland region.
scenes.image_prompt: Final emotional vertical shot showing teacher silhouette against sunrise over misty mountains as children wave goodbye from doorway. Warm golden glow fills frame symbolizing hope and continuity with traditional textiles fluttering in mountain breeze.
